Buying in Dubai? Here's the whole process in 7 steps, from budget to keys 🔑

Save this for later and send it to someone who's planning to buy.

DM "BUY" for a free plan built around your budget.

#DubaiRealEstate #BuyInDubai #DubaiProperty #GoldenVisa #DubaiOffPlan
days.linkedin_caption:
Most first-time buyers in Dubai only budget for the price. The real cost is about 7–8% higher once DLD and agency fees are added.

Here's the full buying process in 7 steps, from setting a real budget to collecting the keys: ready vs off-plan, how escrow protects you, and what the SPA should say about handover and delays.

Save it for when you're ready, or send it to someone who is.

days.caption:
A 10-year UAE residence visa through property 🇦🇪
Who qualifies, what it covers, how to apply. Swipe →

DM "VISA" and I'll send you a shortlist of properties that qualify.

#GoldenVisa #UAEGoldenVisa #DubaiRealEstate #DubaiProperty #InvestInDubai
days.linkedin_caption:
Owning property worth AED 2 million or more in Dubai can qualify you for a 10-year, renewable UAE Golden Visa, covering your spouse and children too.

In the slides: the threshold, how off-plan and mortgaged homes are treated, who the visa covers and the application steps.

Rules change, so always confirm with DLD before buying specifically for the visa.

days.caption:
Dubai's next metro line opens in 2029 🚇 Here's where it runs and why it matters for property.

DM "METRO" for options along the route.

#DubaiMetro #BlueLine #DubaiRealEstate #DubaiInfrastructure #DubaiProperty
days.linkedin_caption:
The Blue Line is a 30 km metro line linking nine districts, from Dubai Creek Harbour and Festival City to International City, Mirdif, Silicon Oasis and Academic City. It's due to open in 2029.

Historically, homes near new transit get easier to rent and resell. The time to look is before the trains run, not after.

#DubaiRealEstate #DubaiDevelopers #DubaiProperty #OffPlanDubai
days.linkedin_caption:
Before you buy into a community, know the developer behind it.

A quick map of Dubai's master developers: the government-backed group under Dubai Holding, the big listed names, the Abu Dhabi arrival and the private builders, plus what each is known for.

Whoever it is, check the delivery record and RERA registration first.

days.caption:
Dubai in 1990 vs today. One generation, a different city 🌆

DM "NEXT" to find out where it's heading next.

#Dubai #DubaiHistory #DubaiSkyline #DubaiRealEstate #MyDubai
days.linkedin_caption:
In 1990, Dubai had about half a million people and Sheikh Zayed Road ran through open desert. Today it has more than 4 million residents and one of the world's busiest airports.

Every phase of that growth rewarded the people who bought early in the next area. The 2040 plan shows where the next one is.

days.caption:
60/40, 70/30, post-handover: what do they actually mean? 💰 Explained on a real AED 3M example.

DM "PLAN" and I'll match a plan to your budget.

#DubaiOffPlan #PaymentPlan #DubaiRealEstate #DubaiProperty #InvestInDubai
days.linkedin_caption:
Off-plan payment plans decide your cash flow for years, so it's worth understanding them properly.

On a AED 3M home: a 60/40 plan means about AED 1.8M during construction and AED 1.2M at handover. A 70/30 plan often comes with a better price, and a post-handover plan lets rent help with the payments.

Always check the plan's dates against the handover date in the SPA.

days.caption:
The Dubai 2040 Master Plan in 6 slides 🗺️ The government's roadmap for where the city grows next.

DM "2040" to see which communities sit closest to the growth centres.

#Dubai2040 #DubaiRealEstate #UrbanPlanning #DubaiProperty #InvestInDubai
days.linkedin_caption:
The Dubai 2040 Urban Master Plan is a 20-year roadmap: 5.8 million residents, six urban centres, double the open space and much more public beach.

For buyers, it works like a map of where infrastructure arrives first. The communities near the new centres and transit are the ones to watch.

days.caption:
Off-plan, ready, resale, secondary: what's the difference? 🏠 Four ways to buy, four different deals.

DM "TYPE" and I'll match one to your budget and timeline.

#DubaiRealEstate #OffPlan #DubaiProperty #BuyInDubai
days.linkedin_caption:
Off-plan, ready, resale, secondary: four terms that confuse most first-time buyers in Dubai.

The short version: off-plan is cheapest and slowest, ready is immediate, resale (also called secondary) is negotiable, and off-plan resale lets you buy closer to handover.

The right one depends on your budget and how soon you need the keys.

days.caption:
Every fee you pay when buying in Dubai, in one place 🧾 Save this before you make an offer.

DM "COSTS" for a full breakdown on the home you're looking at.

#DubaiRealEstate #DLD #BuyInDubai #DubaiProperty
days.linkedin_caption:
The price is not the cost. On top of it come the 4% DLD transfer fee, the trustee office fee, agency fees on resale, mortgage registration and the developer NOC.

As a rule of thumb, budget 7–8% above the price for a ready home. The slides list each fee and who pays it.

days.caption:
Jebel Ali Beach: Dubai's longest public beach 🏖️ 6.6 km, three zones, mangroves and a 2 km swimmable stretch.

DM "BEACH" for the communities next to it.

#JebelAli #DubaiBeach #DubaiRealEstate #PalmJebelAli #DubaiProperty
days.linkedin_caption:
Jebel Ali Beach is set to become Dubai's longest public beach: 6.6 km and 330 hectares under an approved masterplan, with a beach club, a turtle sanctuary, mangroves, a 2 km swimmable beach and a 5 km running track.

Beach access is one of the strongest drivers of rent and resale. The best time to buy near a new beach is before it opens.
